title: Шутка Луи над Шефом  (Louis's Prank on the Chef)

segments.t: After Fedya finishes his story, pastry chef Louis chimes in with the time he nearly got fired for teasing Chef Barinov on a rough morning. Walking in while the Chef was nursing a brutal hangover, Louis cheerfully joked that alcohol had skipped Barinov's liver and gone straight for his brain.
Да ладно, не бери в голову.
Я думал, что алкоголь печень твою вначале разрушит.

'It started with your brain instead.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'with' and finishing on 'started'. Alright, let's hear the whole conversation once more from start to finish.
